home.title: An-Nur Journey
home.tagline: Your companion for Quran reading and prayer times.
home.description: An-Nur Journey helps you read the Quran, track prayer times, find the Qibla direction, browse duas, and connect with a community of fellow Muslims — all in one app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: An-Nur Journey mobile application
privacy.intro: Hupernex ("we", "us", or "our") operates the An-Nur Journey mobile application (the "App"). This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using the App, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.intro: We collect the following categories of information:

rows: Name, email address, profile photo, authentication identifier
Provided by you, or your chosen sign-in provider (Google, Apple, Facebook, or email/password)
Community posts and comments, saved/favorited duas and Quran bookmarks, tasbih (dhikr counter) history, prayer and reading preferences
Created by you within the App
Collected with your permission, used to calculate accurate prayer times and Qibla direction
Used locally on your device for the Qibla compass feature
Generated by your device to deliver prayer time and reminder notifications
Features used, screens viewed, in-app interactions, general device information (model, OS version)
Collected automatically to help us fix bugs and improve stability
Reading progress, app settings, cached content
Stored on your device to let the App work offline

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
list: To provide core features: Quran reading, prayer time calculation, Qibla direction, duas, tasbih counter, and community discussions.
To create and manage your account, and sync your preferences and content across devices.
To send prayer time reminders and other notifications you have enabled.
To understand how the App is used, so we can improve features and fix issues.
To detect, investigate, and prevent fraudulent, abusive, or unlawful activity, and to keep the community features safe.
To communicate with you about updates, support requests, or changes to this policy.

share.heading: How We Share Your Information
share.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:
list: Service providers that help us operate the App, including authentication, database/backend hosting, cloud storage, push notifications, analytics, and crash-reporting providers (such as Google Firebase and Supabase). These providers process data on our behalf and are bound by their own privacy and security obligations.
Other users, limited to content you choose to post publicly in community features (e.g. posts, comments, display name, profile photo).
Legal authorities, where required to comply with applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request.
A successor entity, in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, subject to this policy or a materially similar one.

security.heading: Data Storage and Security
security.body: Your data is stored using reputable third-party cloud infrastructure providers and, where applicable, locally on your device. We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards — including encryption of sensitive data where appropriate — to protect your information. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

choices.heading: Your Choices and Rights
list: Permissions: You can grant or revoke location, notification, and other device permissions at any time through your device settings. Some features (e.g. accurate prayer times, Qibla direction) may not work correctly without the relevant permission.
Notifications: You can disable prayer reminders and other notifications in the App's settings or your device's system settings.
Access and correction: You can review and update your profile information within the App.
Deletion: You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data by contacting us using the details below.
Community content: You may delete content you have posted in community features at any time; be aware that others may have viewed or shared it before deletion.

retention.heading: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the App's features. We may retain and use certain information as necessary to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: The App is intended for a general audience and is suitable for use by families. We do not knowingly collect personal information from young children without appropriate parental consent. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information without such consent, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.

transfers.heading: International Data Transfers
transfers.body: Your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in countries other than your own, including countries where our service providers operate. We take steps to ensure that such transfers are subject to appropriate safeguards in line with applicable data protection laws.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by updating the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, through an in-app notice. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.intro: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us:
